items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: he had his man, Ben Bart to meet us in Cincinnati... this is the date that the money is to be paid

ctx.x: Yes. What we did, I didn't have -- we started on these one-nighters and so he had his man, Ben Bart to meet us in Cincinnati, you know -- this is the date that the money is to be paid and so Ben Bart came up and said, well, man, be glad to have you with the fold and everything, he says, because I know, by God, there's no way you're going to get hold of -- I have forgotten how much it was, but that was my money then, this amount of money.

I said, well, I tell you what, Ben, it's been a pleasure, but I tell you what, I've got your check right here. He says, what. I says, yep, I've got your check right here. Right here it's all in full and I waited till the last night to give it to him. So he was telling me, we'll get ready and go back home, back into New York and I said, well, I tell you, got the check here so everything's all right, it's been a pleasure.
